paymentStep.title: Payment Setup
paymentStep.description: Choose whether to set up Stripe now or complete it after your league is live.
paymentStep.freeLeagueDescription: You have chosen to run a free league. Players will be able to register without making any payment. You can always enable paid registration later in your league settings.
paymentStep.freeLeagueHint: No payment processing is required for free leagues. Simply continue to the next step to complete your league setup.
paymentStep.notConnectedDescription: You can connect Stripe now or set up payments later from your league dashboard. Your league will work without it -- you will just need to collect fees manually.
paymentStep.pendingDescription: Stripe Connect will be configured after your league is created. You will be guided through the setup from your dashboard.
paymentStep.activeDescription: Your Stripe account is active and ready to accept payments.
paymentStep.skippedDescription: No worries! You can connect Stripe anytime from your league dashboard. Until then, you can collect payments manually (cash, e-transfer, etc.).
paymentStep.skippedDetail: Your league will launch without online payments. Players will need to pay you directly. You can enable online payments at any time from Settings > Billing.
paymentStep.stripeAfterCreation: Stripe Connect will be set up after your league is created. Click "Create League" to continue, then complete Stripe onboarding from your dashboard.
paymentStep.pciDescription: Stripe handles all sensitive card data
paymentStep.directDepositsDescription: Funds deposited directly to your bank
paymentStep.platformFeeInfo: A {percent}% platform fee is applied to all player payments. By default, this fee is passed to the player at checkout. You can change this in your league billing settings.
paymentStep.stripeFeeInfo: Stripe also charges their standard card processing fees separately. You can finish Stripe onboarding after league creation if you prefer to launch now.
paymentStep.testModeBanner: Test Mode: You are using Stripe test keys. No real charges will be made.

reviewStep.title: Review & Launch
reviewStep.description: Review your league configuration before launching. You can go back to edit any information.
reviewStep.readyToLaunchDescription: These items are configured and ready to go.
reviewStep.needsAttentionDescription: These items can be set up from your dashboard after creating the league.
reviewStep.stripeSkipped: Not set up yet -- set up from dashboard
reviewStep.stripeNotConnected: Not connected -- set up after launch
reviewStep.warningsDescription: These items are optional and can be configured later from your dashboard.
reviewStep.warningNoTeams: No teams have been added yet. You can add teams later from your dashboard.
reviewStep.warningStripeNotConnected: Registration fees are configured but Stripe is not connected. Players will not be able to pay online until you connect Stripe from your dashboard.
reviewStep.warningNoContact: No contact information provided. Consider adding an email or phone number so players can reach you.
reviewStep.warningNoLogo: No logo uploaded. Adding a logo helps establish your league's brand identity.
reviewStep.readyToLaunchInfo: Once launched, your league will be active and you can start:
reviewStep.ctaManageLeague: Managing your league from the dashboard
reviewStep.paymentSetupReminder: You can set up Stripe payment processing anytime from your dashboard.
reviewStep.stripeSkippedBanner: Payment setup was deferred. You can connect Stripe from your league settings after launch.
